objective: Implement one-owner trust, secure device enrollment, revocation and recovery.
deliverable_refs: Single-use bootstrap, device public-key registry, sessions and rotating refresh credentials.
Device security-level metadata, signed command validation and revocation checks.
Offline recovery procedure and hold/re-enrollment transitions.
required_test_refs: Enrollment replay/race, invalid key binding, lost-device recovery and post-challenge revocation.
No first-user-wins takeover or default password.
Fixture/device trust cannot cross environment namespace.
acceptance_gate: Identity lifecycle passes backend integration; real Keystore/device validation is required with Android work.
